ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can read a thousand chromatographic peaks in minutes, but technicians still decide why the data drifted and whether to repeat the experiment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 57,000 Chemical Technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 59,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,000 jobs, with approximately 6,700 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $57,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Chemical Technicians, but it will take over data processing, report generation, and routine interpretation. Experimental work, troubleshooting, and process tuning still depend on technicians' judgment. Machines cannot replace human vigilance around chemical safety. AI displaces operators who only press buttons, not technicians who understand the principles.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted spectrum interpretation and unknown identification
AI optimization and prediction of process parameters
ai_s2_auto: Automated processing and interpretation of chromatography and spectroscopy data
Automated experiment records and reports
Digital sample management and reagent inventory
Instrument self-tests and automatic data archiving
ai_s3_list: Experimental design and method judgment: determine whether a plan is sound and how to adjust conditions.
Troubleshooting: determine whether data drift or unusual peak shapes come from the instrument or sample.
Chemical-safety vigilance: detect danger through odor, color change, and heat release.
Instrument troubleshooting: repair common problems without delaying schedules.
Process and production awareness: understand the distance from laboratory to plant.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure tier. AI absorbs much data processing and spectrum interpretation, shifting technicians' core value toward experimental execution, troubleshooting, and process judgment. People who understand principles + operate equipment + make judgments become scarcer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Technicians who use AI spectrum tools and automated equipment can double productivity and perform more valuable experiments. People limited to manual work and unable to interpret data become marginalized. Data-analysis skills provide a bridge from operations into R&D.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Chemical technician work offers a high-value science path with entry through an associate or bachelor's degree and broad employment options. Master chromatography and spectroscopy in school, add data analysis, and target pharmaceuticals or advanced materials.

Learn advanced instruments, automated laboratory platforms, AI spectrum tools, and data analysis. Advancing from operations technician to R&D assistant or process engineer is the main path to substantially higher income.

People with chemistry foundations can enter laboratories fastest through analytical technician roles. Highlight instruments such as HPLC, GC, and ICP and examples of independent data handling. Interviewers place high value on safe operating habits.
Evaluate technicians through a practical experiment, not education alone. Automated and AI analysis tools improve throughput and retention because repetitive work is a major source of burnout.

ai_s7_trends: As laboratory automation and AI spectrum interpretation spread, technicians shift from manual operation toward experimental design + data judgment.
Expansion in biopharmaceuticals, advanced materials, and new energy sustains shortages of advanced analytical technicians.
Technicians who combine instrument expertise + data skills + safety awareness are becoming the industry's preferred candidates.

body: Chemical Technicians perform chemical experiments and support processes in laboratories and production environments. They prepare samples, execute experiments, analyze instruments, record data, and monitor process parameters to support product R&D, quality testing, and industrial scale-up.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can read a thousand chromatographic peaks in minutes, but technicians still decide why the data drifted and whether to repeat the experiment.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在三分钟里读完一千个色谱峰，但「这批数据为什么漂移、实验是不是要重做」，还得技术员来判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年化学技术员在岗约 5.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.90 万人，净增约 0.20 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.67 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.78 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代化学技术员，但会接管数据处理、报告生成和常规判读。实验操作、异常排查、工艺调试这些环节依然靠技术员的专业判断——尤其化学品安全这件事，机器替代不了人的警觉。AI 取代的是「只会按键跑流程」的操作员，不是懂原理的技术员。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助谱图解析与未知物识别
自动化实验与高通量筛选系统
工艺参数 AI 优化与预测
数字孪生辅助中试放大
ai_s2_auto: 色谱、光谱数据自动处理与判读
实验记录与报告自动生成
样品管理、试剂库存电子化
仪器自检与数据自动归档
ai_s3_list: 实验设计与方法判断：方案是否靠谱、条件怎么调。
异常排查：数据漂了、峰形怪了，根因在仪器还是样品。
化学品安全警觉：气味、变色、放热里的危险信号。
仪器故障处理：常见问题自己修，不耽误工期。
工艺与生产的现场感：实验室到车间的距离感。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明数据处理和谱图判读正被 AI 大幅接管，技术员的核心价值转向实验执行、异常排查与工艺判断；「懂原理 + 会操作 + 能判断」的技术员反而更稀缺。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：会用 AI 谱图工具和自动化设备的技术员效率翻倍，能做更多高价值实验；固守手动操作、不会看数据的会被边缘化。把「数据分析」补上，就是从操作岗走向研发岗的跳板。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 化学技术员是性价比高的理工科路径：大专/本科即可入行，就业面广。建议孩子在校就把色谱、光谱这些仪器练熟，辅修数据分析，往制药、新材料方向走更有前景。
把高端仪器、自动化实验平台和 AI 谱图工具学起来，补数据分析能力。从「操作技术员」向「研发助理 / 工艺工程师」进阶，是收入翻倍的主要路径。
有化学基础想进实验室，从分析技术员起步最快；简历突出你熟练的仪器（HPLC、GC、ICP 等）和独立处理数据的案例。安全操作意识是面试官最看重的软实力。
招技术员别只看学历，现场演示一次实验就知深浅；给团队配自动化与 AI 分析工具，能明显提升通量和留人率——技术员最怕重复劳动磨掉热情。

ai_s7_trends: 实验室自动化与 AI 谱图解析普及，技术员从「手动操作」转向「实验设计 + 数据判断」。
生物医药、新材料、新能源产业扩张，高端分析技术员持续稀缺。
「懂仪器 + 会数据 + 有安全素养」的复合型技术员成为行业首选。

body: 化学技术员在实验室与生产现场执行化学实验与工艺支持工作，负责样品制备、实验操作、仪器分析、数据记录与工艺参数监控，支撑产品研发、质量检测与工业化放大。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can monitor hundreds of camera feeds, but a correctional officer on patrol still has to notice when an incarcerated person's behavior looks wrong that day.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 387,500 Correctional officers and bailiffs were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 357,400 by 2034, a net loss of about 30,100 jobs, with about 30,100 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $58,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Correctional officers and bailiffs, but it will change how they monitor security. Smart correctional systems, AI behavior recognition, and automated counts can warn of abnormal behavior earlier. People are still needed for facility patrols, conflict response, counseling, and rehabilitation. AI identifies an anomaly; officers decide how to respond and communicate.
ai_s2_accel: Emotion-recognition assistance: analyzes facial expressions and vocal emotion for alerts
Smart access control and positioning: tracks movements of people in custody
Psychological assessment tools: AI assists mental-health screening
Emergency command platform: coordinates dispatch for sudden incidents
ai_s2_auto: Smart count system: facial recognition assists headcounts
AI behavior recognition: automatically flags abnormal conduct and early signs of group incidents
Smart correctional platform: digitizes facility data and records management
Electronic patrol logs: automatically archive patrol routes and records
ai_s3_list: Observation during facility patrols: experienced officers notice mood changes and early warning signs.
Real-time judgment in conflict response: experience guides how to control an incident without escalating it.
Communication in counseling and rehabilitation: encouraging people in custody to speak and participate requires interpersonal skill.
Commitment to safety fundamentals: details matter in contraband searches and escape prevention.
Balance between humane treatment and discipline: enforce rules strictly while respecting people undergoing correction.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. About half the tasks occur at desks or monitoring screens. AI assists counts, records, and data, but people still perform patrols, resolve conflicts, and conduct counseling and rehabilitation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. AI makes security smarter and directs officers toward the work requiring them most. Passive roles limited to watching screens face pressure, while officers who use smart platforms and conduct effective rehabilitation become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study at a police academy or in law and public administration, then enter the justice administration system or court bailiff service through civil-service recruitment. Prepare early for background checks and physical and psychological tests. Officers who use smart correctional platforms and understand psychological rehabilitation have stronger prospects.

Learn smart correctional platforms and psychological assessment tools rather than remaining limited to monitoring. Develop expertise in rehabilitation, psychological correction, and correctional administration; higher professional barriers add value.

Correctional police and bailiff roles require recruitment examinations and have high entry barriers. Justice support or security-management roles can provide related experience. Quantify results on your resume, including the number of people managed, safety records, and rehabilitation cases.

Do not hire based on physical ability alone. Assess psychological resilience and communication. Officers who command a scene, conduct effective conversations, and tolerate pressure in closed environments are scarce; prioritize their training and advancement to reduce turnover.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Digitize facility data, records, and processes
Automatically detect group incidents and abnormal behavior
Track movements of people in custody
Manage education courses and rehabilitation records

ai_s7_trends: Justice administration recruitment remains stable, and correctional police systems maintain recurring staffing needs.
Smart correctional facilities and AI security are becoming standard. Smarter monitoring and records management combine personnel and technology to improve safety margins.
Correctional officers are evolving from guards into combined safety-management and rehabilitation professionals, with psychological correction skills gaining importance.

body: Correctional officers and bailiffs manage people held in prisons and detention centers, maintain safety, and support rehabilitation. They conduct counts and patrols, supervise transport and custody, and maintain courtroom order as frontline law-enforcement and management personnel in the justice system.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can monitor hundreds of camera feeds, but a correctional officer on patrol still has to notice when an incarcerated person's behavior looks wrong that day.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能盯住几百路监控画面，但监室里谁今天眼神不对劲，还得狱警巡查时亲眼看出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年惩教官与法警在岗约 38.75 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 35.74 万人，岗位净减约 3.01 万个，年均产生约 3.01 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.80 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代惩教官，但会改变「盯防」的方式。以前靠人工巡查和盯监控，现在有智慧监狱系统、AI 行为识别、智能点名辅助，异常行为能提前预警。可监区巡查、冲突处置、谈话教育这些核心，还得靠人——AI 告诉你「有异常」，但怎么处置、怎么谈话，是狱警的活。
ai_s2_accel: 情绪识别辅助：面部表情与语音情绪分析提示
智能门禁与定位：在押人员移动轨迹管理
心理评估工具：AI 辅助心理健康筛查
应急指挥平台：突发警情一键联动调度
ai_s2_auto: 智能点名系统：人脸识别辅助人数清点
AI 行为识别：异常行为、聚众苗头自动预警
智慧监狱平台：监区数据、档案管理数字化
巡查记录电子化：巡查轨迹与记录自动归档
ai_s3_list: 监区巡查的观察力：谁情绪不对、谁有苗头，一眼看出是行家功夫。
冲突处置的临场判断：突发的冲突怎么控制、怎么不激化，靠经验。
谈话教育的沟通艺术：怎么让在押人员开口、接受改造，是软技能。
安全底线意识：违禁品检查、脱逃防范，细节就是生命线。
人道与纪律的平衡：严格执行规则，又不失对改造对象的尊重。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半任务在桌面和监控屏前——点名、档案、数据正被 AI 辅助，但监区巡查、冲突处置、谈话教育这些核心，AI 只能帮忙看，不能替人做。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 让安防更智能：行为识别、智能点名让警力用到刀刃上。真正被挤压的是「纯盯监控、不碰教育」的被动值守方式，会用智慧平台、能做好教育改造的狱警反而更受重用。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读警校或政法类专业，走公务员招录进司法行政系统或法院法警队。政审、体能、心理测试要提前准备。AI 时代，会用智慧监狱平台、懂心理矫治的狱警更吃香，这是稳定且有保障的职业路。
把智慧监狱平台、心理评估工具用起来，别停留在「纯盯防」。往教育改造、心理矫治、狱政管理方向走，专业壁垒越高越有价值。
监狱警察和法警都走招录考试，门槛高；可先从司法辅助、安保管理岗切入积累。简历上写「管理在押人员数、安全记录、教育改造案例」这类可量化成果。
招人别只看体能，要看心理素质和沟通能力。能镇场、会谈话、扛得住封闭环境压力的狱警，是稀缺力量，值得在培训和晋升上倾斜，降低流失率。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 监区数据、档案、流程数字化
聚众、异常行为自动检测
AI 辅助心理健康评估
教育课程、改造档案管理

ai_s7_trends: 司法行政系统招录稳定，监狱警察常年有编制需求，岗位缺口稳定存在。
智慧监狱与 AI 安防成为标配，监控和档案管理更智能，人防技防结合提升安全边际。
狱警角色从「看守者」向「安全管控 + 教育改造复合型」升级，心理矫治能力越来越受重视。

body: 惩教官与法警是惩教官负责监狱、看守所在押人员的日常管理、安全管控与教育改造，执行点名巡查、押解看管和法庭秩序维护等任务，是司法刑罚执行体系中的一线执法与管理。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能盯住几百路监控画面，但监室里谁今天眼神不对劲，还得狱警巡查时亲眼看出来。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A model can calculate an initial score quickly, but an analyst still traces whether related companies are moving assets between themselves.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 67,800 Credit Analysts were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 64,800 by 2034, a net loss of about 3,000 jobs, with roughly 3,700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $81,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Credit Analysts, but it will take over initial reviews and alerts. Data collection, scoring models, and warning systems are highly automated. Analysts are shifting from calculating scores toward industry assessment, complex credit structures, exception decisions, and accountable approvals. Template-only reviewers face the greatest pressure, while deep analytical judgment becomes more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted assessment of industry and supply-chain risk
Knowledge graphs that identify related-party transactions
ai_s2_auto: Automatic collection and cleaning of financial statements and transaction data
Automated initial assessment with basic credit-scoring models
Automated post-loan alerts and unusual-transaction monitoring
Automatic aggregation of credit reports and public information
ai_s3_list: Industry assessment: people interpret cycles and barriers.
Complex credit: people design the structure.
Exception decisions: people decide under ambiguity.
Due-diligence fraud detection: people trace relationships.
Accountable approval: people carry the risk.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high AI exposure range for initial reviews. Systems take over data scoring and alerts at scale, while people retain credit judgment and accountability.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high occupational risk. AI replaces template-based initial reviews, not the full job of making credit decisions. Analysts who assess industries, structure complex credit, and accept approval responsibility become scarcer as models spread. Template-only scoring work is most vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through undergraduate finance or accounting, then practice financial statement analysis and modeling. Initial reviews are shrinking in the AI era, so learn industry research and due diligence early.
Move from producing initial reviews toward industry assessment and complex credit. Learn model interpretation and due diligence, then compete for senior analysis or risk-management roles.
Emphasize analytical depth and accountable decision experience. Specify the industries and credit structures you handled. Institutions value consistency and accuracy.
Do not hire only for model operation. Assess industry understanding and willingness to own decisions. Analysts who independently issue and sign opinions merit higher grades.

ai_s7_trends: Initial reviews and alerts are highly automated.
Industry assessment and complex credit receive greater emphasis.
Hybrid analysts who understand model interpretation and due diligence are in greater demand.

body: Credit Analysts evaluate the repayment capacity and credit risk of companies or individuals at financial institutions. They analyze financial statements, bank transactions, and credit records, use or build scoring models, recommend credit limits and conditions, and monitor warning signals.
career_ai_description_block.heading: A model can calculate an initial score quickly, but an analyst still traces whether related companies are moving assets between themselves.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 模型能把初评分数算得飞快，但那家关联公司是不是在左手倒右手，还是分析师一笔笔勾出来的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年信用分析师在岗约 6.78 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.48 万人，岗位净减约 0.30 万个，年均产生约 0.37 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.10 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代信用分析师，但会接管初评与预警。数据抓取、评分模型和预警已高度自动化，分析师从「算分数」挪向「行业研判、复杂授信、例外决策、担责签字」。真正被挤掉的是只填模板出初评的人，能做深度研判的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 行业与产业链风险的智能研判
大模型辅助撰写分析摘要
知识图谱识别关联交易
ai_s2_auto: 财报与流水数据的自动抓取清洗
基础信用评分模型的自动初评
贷后预警与异常交易的自动监测
征信与公开信息的自动汇总
ai_s3_list: 行业研判：周期与壁垒靠人读。
复杂授信：结构靠人设计。
例外决策：模糊里靠人定。
尽调识假：关联靠人抠。
担责签字：风险靠人扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的初评区——数据评分预警被系统大规模接管，但授信判断和担责还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「模板化初评」动作，不是「授信判断」的岗位。能做行业研判和复杂授信、敢签字担责的人，反而随模型普及更稀缺。怕的是只会填模板出分的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 金融财会本科打底，在校多练财报和建模。AI 时代初评在缩，早点学行业研究和尽调。
从「出初评」升级成「行业研判 + 复杂授信」，学模型解释和尽调，争取转高级或风控管理。
突出分析深度和担责经验，写清做过哪些行业和授信结构。机构看重稳和准。
选人别只看会跑模型，要看行业理解和担责意识。能独立出意见签字的，值得给高岗级。

ai_s7_trends: 初评与预警高度自动化。
行业研判与复杂授信更受重视。
懂模型解释和尽调的复合分析师更抢手。

body: 信用分析师在金融机构评估企业或个人的偿债能力与信用风险，分析财务报表、银行流水与征信记录，运用或构建评分模型，出具授信额度与条件建议，并跟踪预警。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 模型能把初评分数算得飞快，但那家关联公司是不是在左手倒右手，还是分析师一笔笔勾出来的。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can assign work orders and predict equipment failures, but people still decide which vendor to trust and which floor to notify first during a water outage.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 151,400 Facilities Managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 157,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 5,700 jobs, with about 13,200 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $104,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not eliminate Facilities Managers, but it will reshape the role. Work-order routing, energy analysis, and inspection records are increasingly automated through service platforms and the Internet of Things. Growth now comes from energy retrofits, smart-building projects, and data-driven decisions. People still set repair priorities, manage vendors, balance budgets, and answer to owners and tenants during critical events.
ai_s2_accel: Sensor-based equipment failure prediction through predictive maintenance
AI-assisted analysis of abnormal energy use and savings opportunities
Smart-building coordination of HVAC and lighting systems
AI comparison of vendor bids and contract terms
ai_s2_auto: Automatic assignment and status tracking for repair work orders
Automatic collection of energy-use data and report generation
Digital inspection check-ins and records
Automated cleaning schedules and work-order reminders
ai_s3_list: Failure triage: decide what to repair first and whether operations must stop.
Vendor management: negotiate prices, evaluate quality, and control delivery.
Budgets and costs: keep operations running and control spending within a limited budget.
Emergency response and communication: coordinate people on site and calm concerns.
Compliance and risk: recognize hard limits for fire safety, elevators, and hazardous materials.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. Work orders, energy data, and inspection records are highly digitized and easy to automate. Management decisions, interpersonal coordination, and on-site emergency response remain far less automated, which keeps the overall score in the middle.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure is not a reason for alarm. A Facilities Manager who uses a smart-building platform can oversee work that once required two people. That productivity can support promotion. The key is to adopt the tools early instead of waiting for systems to change the role around you.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Mechanical, HVAC, property management, and engineering management programs can all lead into this field. Add coursework in data analysis or energy management. School provides the foundation, but project experience teaches you to balance equipment, budgets, and people.
Focus on energy efficiency and carbon reduction, which will benefit from policy investment, and on smart-building platforms. Data skills distinguish you from managers who only cover the site.

People with engineering, property, or administrative experience often transition smoothly. In interviews, go beyond saying that you managed cleaning services. Quantify energy reductions and vendor savings.

The hardest Facilities Managers to hire can control costs and take responsibility under pressure. Favor candidates who have managed real project budgets and completed incident reviews. Clear authority and budget flexibility often retain them better than pay alone.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Centralized control of HVAC, lighting, and elevators
Real-time monitoring of temperature, humidity, leaks, and electrical current
Visualization of workstations and meeting rooms

ai_s7_trends: Carbon-reduction targets and energy retrofits are moving facilities management to the center of corporate cost control.
Smart buildings are shifting from optional upgrades to standard infrastructure, making data-driven operations a basic requirement.
The role is moving from repair and supervision toward data interpretation, cost analysis, and solution design.

body: Facilities Managers oversee the overall operation of buildings and workplaces. They coordinate equipment maintenance, cleaning and landscaping, space and energy management, vendors and contracts, safety, and compliance so buildings operate safely, efficiently, and sustainably.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can assign work orders and predict equipment failures, but people still decide which vendor to trust and which floor to notify first during a water outage.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动派工单、能预测设备故障，但「哪家供应商值得托付、停水了先通知哪层楼」，还是要人来拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年设施经理在岗约 15.14 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 15.71 万人，净增约 0.57 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.32 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.47 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会让设施经理消失，但会重塑这个岗位：报修分派、能耗分析、巡检记录这类工作正在被工单系统和物联网自动完成，岗位的增量来自节能改造、智能楼宇项目和数据决策。真正需要人的，是故障优先级判断、供应商管理、预算平衡，以及关键时刻向业主和租户交代。
ai_s2_accel: 基于传感器预测设备故障（预测性维护）
AI 辅助分析能耗异常与节能空间
智能楼宇系统联动空调照明
供应商报价与合同条款的 AI 比对
ai_s2_auto: 报修工单的自动分派与状态跟踪
能耗数据的自动采集与报表生成
巡检打卡与记录电子化
保洁排班与工单提醒自动化
ai_s3_list: 故障判断：设备报警时判断先修什么、停不停工。
供应商管理：谈判价格、评估质量、把控交付。
预算与成本：在有限预算里保运转、压成本。
应急与沟通：事故现场协调各方、安抚情绪。
合规与风险：消防、电梯、危化品等红线意识。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明设施经理处于「半自动化」地带：工单、能耗、巡检这些数据面已经高度数字化，AI 接手毫不费力；但管理决策、人际协调和现场应急这几块，自动化程度依然有限，所以综合评分是中间值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 别被「数据面 AI 强」吓到：会用智能楼宇平台的设施经理，一个人能管过去两个人管的项目，这种效率优势在行业里就是晋升资本。关键是主动把工具用起来，而不是等系统来淘汰你。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入这行，选机电、暖通、物业或工程管理专业都行，但一定要辅修点数据分析或能源管理。学校里学的东西只是地基，真正的本事是进项目后把设备、预算、人这三样盘明白。
把精力放在两个方向上：一是节能与碳中和，这是未来几年的政策红利；二是智能楼宇平台，会用数据工具就比只会跑现场的人高一档。
有工程、物业、行政背景的人转过来最顺。面试时别只讲「我管过保洁」，要讲「我管的项目能耗降了几个点、供应商成本压了多少」，用数字说话。
设施经理难招的是「会算账又能扛事」的人。与其招名校生，不如挖在项目上真正管过预算、出过事故复盘的人；给授权和预算空间，比单纯涨工资更能留人。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 空调照明电梯集中控制
温湿度、漏水、电流实时监测
二维码打卡与问题上报

ai_s7_trends: 碳中和与节能改造把设施管理推到企业成本中心的核心位置。
智能楼宇从「选配」变「标配」，数据化运维成为基本要求。
岗位能力从「会修会管」转向「会看数据、会算账、会做方案」。

body: 设施经理负责建筑设施与工作场所的整体运营管理，统筹设备维护、保洁绿化、空间与能源管理、供应商与合同、安全合规等，保障建筑安全、高效、可持续地运转。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动派工单、能预测设备故障，但「哪家供应商值得托付、停水了先通知哪层楼」，还是要人来拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can reconcile accounts automatically, but Financial Clerks, All Other still decide which outstanding items to investigate, which errors to stop, and how to confirm details with business teams.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Financial Clerks, All Other is projected to rise from about 38,900 in 2024 to 39,400 in 2034. That is a net increase of about 500 jobs, with roughly 4,000 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $52,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Financial Clerks, All Other, but it will reduce routine roles. OCR and automated reconciliation accelerate standard voucher work. Clerks are shifting from data entry to reviewing exceptions, verifying funds, and applying rules. Pure data-entry roles face the most pressure. People who can review financial records become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated voucher recognition
Automated reconciliation
Automated receipts and payments
Automated report generation
ai_s3_list: Review control: people stop errors.
Exception investigation: people resolve bottlenecks.
Rule interpretation: people judge boundaries.
Funds verification: people maintain trust.
Business confirmation: people manage communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high exposure range for finance operations. Systems accelerate standard voucher work, while people still review records and investigate exceptions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high career risk. Automation replaces pure data entry, not the role of guarding financial records. Clerks who review work and stop errors become scarcer as productivity rises. People who only enter transactions face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build skill with financial software and careful review. Pure data entry is shrinking in the AI era, so practice verification early.
Move from transaction entry to review and reconciliation. Learn system rules and seek ownership of an account category.
Highlight attention to detail and financial-system experience. State which account categories you have handled.
Do not hire based only on typing speed. Look for careful, stable reviewers.

ai_s7_trends: Voucher reconciliation is becoming automated.
Demand for review roles remains steady.
Financial clerks with strong system skills are in greater demand.

body: Financial Clerks, All Other coordinate an organization's cash transactions and vouchers. They process receipts and payments, record and reconcile accounts, and use financial systems to maintain accurate records.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can reconcile accounts automatically, but Financial Clerks, All Other still decide which outstanding items to investigate, which errors to stop, and how to confirm details with business teams.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动对账，但哪笔挂账要查、哪个差错要拦、怎么跟业务方确认，还是财务文员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年其他财务事务文员在岗约 3.89 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.94 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.40 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.21 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代财务文员，但会压缩标准岗。OCR 与自动对账把常规凭证活儿提速，文员从「录凭证」挪向「复核异常、资金核对、规则判断」。真正被挤掉的是只做纯录入的，会复核的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 凭证自动识别
自动对账
收付款自动
报表自动生成
ai_s3_list: 复核把关：差错靠人拦。
异常排查：卡点靠人。
规则判断：边界靠人。
资金核对：信任靠人。
业务确认：沟通靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的财务区——标准凭证被系统加速，但复核与异常还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「纯录入」动作，不是「账务守门」的岗位。有复核力、能拦差错的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做录单的财务文员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 练财务软件与细心，AI 时代纯录在缩，早点练复核。
从录单升级成复核 + 对账，学系统规则，争取管一类账。
突出细心和财务系统经验，写清跟过哪些类账务。
选人别只看手快，要看有没有复核脑子和稳。

ai_s7_trends: 凭证对账自动化。
复核岗需求稳。
懂系统的财务文员更抢手。

body: 财务文员统筹单位的资金往来与凭证，处理收付款、记账与对账，运用财务系统保障账务准确。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动对账，但哪笔挂账要查、哪个差错要拦、怎么跟业务方确认，还是财务文员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Monitoring systems can detect anomalies, but supervisors still decide how to respond, de-escalate conflict, and coordinate other units.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of First Line Supervisors Of Correctional Officers is projected to decline from about 57,100 in 2024 to 55,500 in 2034. That is a net decrease of about 1,600 jobs, with roughly 4,300 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $76,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace correctional supervisors, but it will accelerate management. Monitoring and scheduling systems automate routine custody work. Supervisors shift from watching screens to incident response, conflict de-escalation, shift leadership, and procedural review. Static watch duties face the most pressure. People who handle incidents and lead teams become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated monitoring checks
Automated schedule generation
Automated headcount verification
Automated record archiving
ai_s3_list: Incident response: people stabilize the scene.
Conflict de-escalation: people read emotions.
Procedural review: people ensure compliance.
Shift leadership and development: people lead the team.
Coordination decisions: people decide whether to activate other units.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate exposure range for correctional supervision. Systems accelerate custody monitoring, but people still handle incidents and lead shifts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high career risk. Systems replace screen-only watch duties, not on-site response. Supervisors who handle incidents and lead people become scarcer as productivity rises. Screen-only personnel face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with criminal-justice fundamentals and practice response procedures. Static watch duties are shrinking in the AI era, so develop shift-leadership skills early.
Move from watching screens to incident response and team leadership. Learn alert systems and pursue responsibility for a housing unit.
Highlight custody and shift-leadership experience. State which facilities or units you have worked in. Employers value steadiness and judgment.
Do not select people on tenure alone. Assess incident judgment. Supervisors who can control a scene merit higher allowances.

ai_s7_trends: Monitoring becomes widespread and reduces static watch roles.
Incident response and shift leadership create opportunities.
Supervisors with strong response skills are in greater demand.

body: First Line Supervisors Of Correctional Officers manage staffing and incident response for front-line shifts in correctional facilities. They coordinate headcounts, unit rounds, and emergencies, using discipline and judgment to maintain order and safety.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Monitoring systems can detect anomalies, but supervisors still decide how to respond, de-escalate conflict, and coordinate other units.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监控能看见异常，但怎么处置、怎么化解冲突、要不要联动，还是主管定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年一线主管官在岗约 5.71 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.55 万人，岗位净减约 0.16 万个，年均产生约 0.43 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.63 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代惩教一线主管，但会提速管理。监控与排班系统把常规看护自动化，主管从「盯屏幕」挪向「现场处置、冲突化解、带班与程序把关」。真正被挤掉的是纯值守，有处置力能带人的更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 监控自动巡检
排班自动生成
点名自动核对
记录自动归档
ai_s3_list: 现场处置：场面靠人稳。
冲突化解：情绪靠人读。
程序把关：合规靠人。
带班育人：队伍靠人带。
联动决策：要不要动靠人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的监管区——看护被系统加速，但处置与带班还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「纯值守盯屏」动作，不是「现场处置」的岗位。有处置力、能带人的主管，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会看监控的。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 政法起步多练处置和程序，AI 时代纯值守在缩，早点练带班。
从「盯屏」升级成「处突 + 带人」，学系统预警，争取管区。
突出值守和带班经验，写清跟过哪些所区。单位看重稳和断。
选人别只看资历，要看有没有处置脑子。能镇场的骨干，值得给高津贴。

ai_s7_trends: 监控普及，值守岗缩。
处突与带班带来机会。
有处置力主管更抢手。

body: 惩教一线主管负责监管场所基层班次的人员调度与现场处置，统筹点名、巡区与突发，运用纪律与判断维持秩序安全。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 监控能看见异常，但怎么处置、怎么化解冲突、要不要联动，还是主管定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate glass-cutting dimensions quickly, but Glaziers still use tape measures to resolve tiny discrepancies in uneven wall openings.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 60,500 workers in 2024, projected to rise to 62,500 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 2,000 jobs, with roughly 5,100 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $55,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Glaziers, but it will change material preparation. Experienced workers once calculated cutting dimensions entirely from judgment, while layout software now optimizes cutting plans and factory prefabrication is increasingly mature. At the jobsite, people still lift glass, install it on walls, and apply sealant without bubbles.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted measurement: laser scanning and AI modeling verify field dimensions
Intelligent lifting equipment: sensor-equipped suction and hoisting systems improve precision
AR installation guidance: projected positioning for openings and fixing points
Construction management applications: digital progress, acceptance, and safety inspections
ai_s2_auto: Automatic glass-cutting layouts: software calculates optimal material plans and reduces waste
CNC cutting and edging equipment: programmatic cutting, grinding, and drilling
Quoting and scheduling software: automatic estimates and construction schedules
BIM and drawing coordination: automatic comparison of field dimensions with design models
ai_s3_list: Field measurement and judgment: people use their eyes and tape measures to understand uneven walls, crooked joints, and nonstandard openings beyond the drawings.
Glass handling and wall installation: machines cannot replace the coordination between people managing weight, angles, and clearances.
Tactile installation and sealing: consistent sealant speed, correctly seated beads, and proper fastening force depend on practiced hands.
Safety judgment at height: experience determines suitable weather and where reinforcement is needed.
Communication with clients and supervisors: people coordinate dimension changes, construction sequences, and installation plans.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a low-moderate AI exposure range. Most work occurs on floors, walls, and glass edges. AI helps calculate and optimize measurements, cutting, and installation, but remains far from performing the physical work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Factory prefabrication and automated layouts reduce manual cutting on site, while installation, sealing, and high-rise work remain essential. Glaziers who read drawings and operate modern equipment become more valuable as AI improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A university degree is unnecessary. Vocational training in construction or interior finishing plus apprenticeship is a strong path. Practice measurement and material calculation, obtain safety credentials, and learn drawing interpretation and layout software.

Do not rely only on manual cutting. Learn automated layout software, CNC cutting, and BIM drawing interpretation, progressing from installation alone toward installation plus material design. Safety and work-at-height credentials are durable career assets.
Begin as an apprentice and learn measurement and basic cutting. Resumes should include measurable results such as completed door and window installations and a record without safety incidents.

Do not hire Glaziers only for strength. Assess drawing interpretation, layout software ability, and safety records. Experienced workers who lead teams and coordinate construction sequences merit higher pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic layout, minimal waste, and cutting lists
Programmatic cutting, grinding, and drilling with high precision
Model measurement, opening verification, and clash detection
Rapid distance and area calculations plus drawing verification
Scheduling, progress, acceptance, and safety inspections
Suction lifting, angle control, and safety limits
Projected positioning for openings and fixing points
Work-at-height registration, weather alerts, and hazard reporting

ai_s7_trends: Factory prefabrication plus site installation is becoming standard, reducing field cutting and shifting Glaziers toward installation, sealing, and repair.
Modular construction and glass curtain-wall design continue increasing glass use, while project demand follows real estate cycles and repair demand remains steadier.
The role is evolving into an installation technician who reads drawings and a site lead who manages work, creating premiums for skilled workers familiar with new equipment.

body: Glaziers measure, cut, handle, install, and seal architectural glass in residential windows, storefronts, curtain walls, partitions, and repair and replacement projects. It is a skilled on-site construction trade.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate glass-cutting dimensions quickly, but Glaziers still use tape measures to resolve tiny discrepancies in uneven wall openings.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把玻璃裁切尺寸算得飞快，但量尺时墙缝那半毫米的误差，还得靠玻璃工手里的卷尺去较真。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年玻璃安装工在岗约 6.05 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.25 万人，净增约 0.20 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.51 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.54 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代玻璃安装工，但会改变「下料」这个环节。以前老师傅全靠脑子和经验算切割尺寸，现在下料软件能自动排版、算出最优切割方案，工厂预制越来越成熟。可到了现场，玻璃怎么抬、怎么上墙、打胶怎么不气泡，还是人的活。
ai_s2_accel: AI 量尺辅助：激光扫描 + AI 建模辅助复核现场尺寸
智能吊装辅助设备：带传感器的吸盘与起重设备提升精度
AR 安装指引：现场投影辅助定位开孔与固定点
工程管理 App：进度、验收、安全巡检数字化
ai_s2_auto: 玻璃切割自动排版：软件自动计算最优下料方案，减少废料
数控切割与磨边设备：按程序完成切、磨、钻
报价与排期软件：自动生成报价单和施工排期
BIM 与图纸协同：现场尺寸与设计模型自动比对提醒
ai_s3_list: 现场量尺与判断：墙不平、缝不直、门洞尺寸不标准，这些「图纸之外的真实」，得靠眼睛和卷尺去摸清。
玻璃搬运与上墙配合：重物、角度、间隙，两个人配合的默契，机器替代不了。
安装与密封的手感：打胶匀速、压条到位、紧固力度合适，都是手上功夫。
高空作业的安全判断：什么天气能上、什么位置要加固，经验就是保命线。
与客户和工长的沟通：现场改尺寸、协调工序、解释安装方案，靠的是人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分工作在地上、在墙上、在玻璃边上——量尺、切割、安装这些现场任务，AI 能帮忙算和优化，但离「替人上手」还很远。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。真正被压缩的是「纯手工下料」的不可替代性——工厂预制和自动排版让现场切割变少了，可安装、密封、高空作业这些核心环节，AI 越强越需要能落地的玻璃工去执行，会看图纸、会用新设备的师傅反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行不必读大学，职校的建筑工程施工、装饰技术类专业加学徒实践是好路线。重点练量尺算料基本功，顺带把安全证书考了。AI 时代，会看图纸、会用下料软件的玻璃工会更受欢迎。
别只会手工下料。把自动排版软件、数控切割、BIM 看图补起来，从「纯安装工」往「安装 + 下料设计」走。安全证书、高处作业证这些别省，是职业护城河。
没有经验就从跟师傅当学徒开始，先学量尺和基础切割。简历上写「独立完成门窗安装数」「无安全事故记录」这类可量化成果，比空喊能吃苦有用。
招玻璃工别只看力气，要看「会不会看图纸、会不会用下料软件、安全记录怎么样」。能独立带队、会协调工序的熟手，比只会闷头干活的更值得高薪留。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 自动排版、最小废料、切割清单
模型测距、洞口核对、碰撞检查
快速测距、面积计算、复核图纸
排期、进度、验收、安全巡检
吸盘吊装、角度控制、安全限位
现场投影定位开孔与固定点
高处作业报备、天气预警、隐患上报

ai_s7_trends: 工厂预制 + 现场安装成为主流，现场切割下料减少，玻璃工重心转向「安装、密封、检修」。
装配式建筑和玻璃幕墙审美继续推高玻璃用量，但项目波动随地产周期走，维修更换需求更稳。
玻璃工角色升级为「会看图的安装技师 + 会管现场的小工头」，懂新设备的熟练工溢价明显。

body: 玻璃安装工负责建筑玻璃的测量、切割、搬运、安装与密封，覆盖住宅门窗、商铺橱窗、玻璃幕墙、隔断与玻璃维修更换等场景，是建筑装饰行业里典型的现场技术工种。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把玻璃裁切尺寸算得飞快，但量尺时墙缝那半毫米的误差，还得靠玻璃工手里的卷尺去较真。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can schedule repairs, but machines cannot replace on-site coordination and awareness of how to move equipment, route cables, or anticipate a technician's next need.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 98,700 installation, maintenance, and repair helpers employed in 2024, projected to reach 101,000 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 2,300 jobs, with roughly 11,800 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $38,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace installation and maintenance helpers because moving equipment, handing over materials, and assisting are physical, collaborative tasks performed on site. AI can improve dispatching, spare-parts management, and digital work reporting, but people still provide every physical effort and coordinated action at installation and repair sites. Near-term replacement risk is low.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent location of tools and spare parts
ai_s2_auto: Digital work-order dispatch and scheduling
Automated spare parts inventory management
Mobile work reporting and attendance
Photographic installation-progress records
ai_s3_list: Strength and endurance: moving loads across different elevations is essential.
Situational awareness: anticipate what the technician will need next.
Tool handling: use wrenches and levels confidently.
Safety awareness: follow rules around equipment, electricity, and elevated work.
Learning the trade: absorb skilled technicians' operating methods.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places installation and maintenance helpers in a low-moderate exposure support role. Scheduling and reporting are digitizing, but on-site moving and coordination cannot be automated. Replacement risk comes mainly from the role's own substitutability rather than AI: helpers are plentiful and entry barriers low, while advancement to technician creates competitiveness.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not guarantee security. Helper labor is readily available and earnings have a low ceiling. Learn actively, earn credentials, and advance to technician quickly to counter substitutability.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For students without an academic advantage, skilled trade work is a practical path. Start as an installation and maintenance helper, choose a direction such as electrical or HVAC work, and earn electrician or welding certificates while working. Advancing to technician in two or three years can provide earnings comparable to office work, with value increasing through experience.

Do not remain positioned as a helper. Learn proactively from technicians, earn electrical, welding, and refrigeration credentials, and begin taking jobs independently. With experience, advance to specialist technician or crew leadership, where project- and hour-based pay offers substantially more room.

Installation and maintenance offers a low barrier for career changers: physical fitness and willingness to learn are sufficient. Prioritize specialties such as HVAC, elevators, or power, and join an experienced technician or engineering crew with steady projects. In interviews, emphasize resilience, dexterity, and safety awareness.

Helper turnover is high, and retention depends on a learning path plus steady projects. Promising credential reimbursement and a route to technician status for motivated helpers costs less than constant recruiting. Strong safety training also improves retention.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Reduce effort in cutting and drilling
Virtual annotations for key installation steps
Reduce effort when lifting heavy loads

ai_s7_trends: An aging installation and repair workforce increases the value of learning and advancing.
As digital tools spread, helpers also need to report work through apps.
Demand is steadier in specialties such as HVAC, elevators, and power.

body: Installation and maintenance helpers assist skilled technicians during equipment installation, maintenance, and repair. They move equipment and parts, pull cable, secure brackets, clean work areas, hand over tools, and organize sites.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can schedule repairs, but machines cannot replace on-site coordination and awareness of how to move equipment, route cables, or anticipate a technician's next need.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能排好维修计划，但「设备怎么搬、线怎么拉、师傅下一步要什么」——现场的配合和眼力，机器替不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年安装维护工人修理在岗约 9.87 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.10 万人，净增约 0.23 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.18 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.89 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代安装维护帮工：搬运、递料、打下手全是物理现场的体力与配合活。AI 能帮的是派单、备件管理、报工数字化，但安装维修现场的每一把力气和每一次配合，还得靠人，这岗位短期替代风险很低。
ai_s2_accel: 设备安装 AR 辅助指导
工地安全 AI 监控
ai_s2_auto: 工单派发与排期数字化
备件库存自动管理
报工与考勤移动化
安装进度拍照记录
ai_s3_list: 体力与耐力：搬运上高下低是刚需。
眼力见：预判师傅下一步要什么。
工具手感：扳手、水平尺用得顺手。
安全意识：设备、电气、高处作业守规矩。
学艺吸收：把技工的操作要领学到手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明安装维护帮工是「中高曝光」的辅助体力岗：排期报工被数字化，但现场搬运和配合无法自动化，替代风险主要来自「岗位本身的可替代性」而非 AI——帮工多、门槛低，转正技工才有竞争力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高枕无忧：帮工岗位供给充足，收入天花板低。把偷师的功夫用好，尽快考证转技工，才是对冲「可替代性」的正解。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历不占优势的孩子走技术蓝领是务实路线：从安装维修帮工干起，选水电、暖通等方向，边干边考电工证、焊工证，两三年转正式技工，收入不比坐办公室差，且越老越吃香。
定位别停在「帮工」：主动跟师傅学，把电工、焊工、制冷证书考下来，尽快独立接活；有一定经验后往专项技师或带班走，收入按项目和工时算，空间大得多。
转行进安装维修门槛低：有体力、肯学就行。选择时优先暖通、电梯、电力等专项领域，跟着有活源的师傅或工程队，面试对接时突出能吃苦、手脚麻利、有安全意识。
帮工流动性大，留人靠「学艺路径 + 稳定活源」：给愿意学的帮工承诺「考证报销 + 转技工通道」，比不断招新划算；把安全培训做扎实，也是留住人的竞争力。

ai_s7_trends: 安装维修技师老龄化，学艺转正价值上升。
工具数字化普及，帮工也要会用 App 报工。
专项领域（暖通、电梯、电力）需求更稳。

body: 安装维护帮工在设备安装、维护与修理作业中为熟练技工提供辅助，负责设备与零件搬运、线缆拉放、支架固定、作业面清理、工具递送与现场整理。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能排好维修计划，但「设备怎么搬、线怎么拉、师傅下一步要什么」——现场的配合和眼力，机器替不了。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Intelligent dispatch can replace monitoring, but safety decision-making, cross-party coordination and emergency response are still determined by managers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), there will be approximately 241,900 production managers on the job in 2024, and this number is expected to rise to 246,500 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 4,600 positions, an average of approximately 17,100 job vacancies per year, and a median annual salary of approximately US$121,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI won’t replace hydropower production managers, but it will compress monitoring. Predictive maintenance and intelligent dispatch speed up routine load adjustment, and managers move from "monitoring the curve" to "safety decision-making, dispatch coordination, emergency command, team and compliance management." Those who are really squeezed out are those who only monitor screens. People who understand hydraulic engineering and electrical engineering are more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent load scheduling
Predictive Maintenance
Automated inspections
Automated report generation
ai_s3_list: Safety decision-making: The decision depends on people.
Scheduling and coordination: rely on people across parties.
Emergency command: Disposal depends on people.
Team management: people rely on people to lead.
Compliance control: Responsibility lies with people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 shows that this profession is in the medium AI exposure area-monitoring and dispatching are accelerated by the system, but decision-making and emergency response still leave human positions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium and high exposure does not mean high risk: what is replaced is "screen monitoring and recording", not the composite post of "security + dispatch + emergency response". People with systematic judgment become more and more scarce as their effectiveness improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you are starting out in hydropower/electrical, you should learn more about hydraulic engineering and electrical engineering. The pure monitoring screen is shrinking, so practice decision-making early.
Upgrade from "duty leader" to "scheduling + management" and learn safety and compliance.
Highlight the experience and qualifications of the power station and write down which units have been pigged.
When selecting people, don’t just look at their diplomas, but whether they can handle the decision-making process.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent scheduling is popularized and monitoring screens are reduced.
Clean energy drives demand.
People who can make decisions are more in demand.

body: The hydropower production manager coordinates the power generation process and unit operation and maintenance of the hydropower station, and is responsible for load dispatch, maintenance coordination, safety compliance and team management.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Intelligent dispatch can replace monitoring, but safety decision-making, cross-party coordination and emergency response are still determined by managers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 智能调度能替监控，但安全决策、跨方协调与应急还是经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年生产经理在岗约 24.19 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 24.65 万人，净增约 0.46 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.71 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.14 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代水电生产经理，但会压缩监控。预测性维护与智能调度把常规调负荷提速，经理从「盯曲线」挪向「安全决策、调度协调、应急指挥、团队与合规管理」。真正被挤掉的是只做监屏的，懂水工机电能拍板的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 智能负荷调度
预测性维护
自动巡检
报表自动生成
ai_s3_list: 安全决策：拍板靠人。
调度协调：跨方靠人。
应急指挥：处置靠人。
团队管理：人靠人带。
合规把关：责任靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——监控调度被系统加速，但决策与应急还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「监屏记录」，不是「安全 + 调度 + 应急」的复合岗。有系统判断力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 水电/电气起步多学水工机电，纯监屏在缩，早点练决策。
从「值长」升级成「调度+管理」，学安全合规。
突出电站经验和资质，写清管过哪些机组。
选人别只看文凭，要看能不能扛调度拍板。

ai_s7_trends: 智能调度普及，监屏缩。
清洁能源拉需求。
会决策的人更抢手。

body: 水电生产经理统筹水电站发电流程与机组运维，负责负荷调度、检修协调、安全合规与团队管理。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 智能调度能替监控，但安全决策、跨方协调与应急还是经理定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Scoring can be automated, but psychologists still decide which item reveals the problem, how to explain it, and how to plan intervention.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 55,300 neuropsychologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 57,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,400 jobs, with roughly 3,900 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $117,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these roles, but it will accelerate scoring and analysis. Automated scoring and imaging assistance speed up routine assessments, shifting people from calculating scores toward assessment integration, intervention planning, research, and communication. Roles limited to standard scoring will lose ground, while professionals who integrate findings and provide interventions become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated test scoring
Imaging segmentation
Report templates
Data entry
ai_s3_list: Assessment integration: people assemble the full picture.
Intervention planning: people choose the path.
Patient communication: people build trust.
Research design: people develop the ideas.
Complex judgment: people uphold the standard.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation at moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate scoring and imaging, while people remain essential for assessment integration.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Standard scoring is being replaced, not roles that interpret the brain and develop a patient profile. Professionals who integrate findings and provide interventions become even scarcer as efficiency rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong foundation in statistics and brain science. Pure scoring work is shrinking, so develop integration and intervention skills early.
Progress from calculating scores to assessment + intervention + research and work toward becoming a PI.
Emphasize training and results. Institutions value consistency and specialization.
Do not hire based only on education. Assess integration and communication skills. Core professionals who can establish a research direction deserve a strong platform.

ai_s7_trends: Automated scoring becomes widespread, reducing scoring work.
Imaging assistance expands.
Professionals who integrate findings become more sought after.

body: Neuropsychologists study relationships between the brain and behavior. They use cognitive tests and brain imaging to assess memory, attention, and other abilities, support diagnosis of brain injury, and develop rehabilitation and intervention plans.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Scoring can be automated, but psychologists still decide which item reveals the problem, how to explain it, and how to plan intervention.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 计分能自动，但哪题暴露问题、怎么讲、干预怎么定，还是心理学家的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年神经心理学家在岗约 5.53 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.77 万人，净增约 0.24 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.76 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会加速计分与分析。自动计分与成像辅助把常规评估提速，人从「算分」挪向「评估整合、干预规划、科研、沟通」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准计分的，会整合、能做干预的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 测验自动计分
成像分割
报告模板
数据录入

医患沟通：信任靠人。
科研设计：思路靠人。
复杂判断：底线靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光——计分与成像被系统加速，但评估整合还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准计分」动作，不是「读脑定画像」的岗位。会整合、能做干预的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

成像辅助渗透。
会整合的人更抢手。

body: 神经心理学家研究脑与行为的关系，通过认知测验与脑成像评估记忆、注意等能力，辅助诊断脑损伤并制定康复与干预方案。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 计分能自动，但哪题暴露问题、怎么讲、干预怎么定，还是心理学家的人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Robots can coat uniform panels, but experienced workers still handle the corners of irregular parts and repair work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that in 2024, about 8,800 painting and coating workers were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 8,900, a net increase of about 100 jobs, with about 800 openings per year. In 2026, the median annual salary is about $40,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace painting and coating workers, but it will reshape work on uniform parts. Automated coating lines and visual inspection take over panels, shifting workers from labor-intensive spraying toward coating irregular parts, managing processes, and protecting appearance quality. Simple repetitive spraying faces displacement, while workers with steady hands and process knowledge become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Robotic spraying of uniform parts
Automated online coating-thickness measurement
Initial visual screening for appearance defects
Automated recording of drying parameters
ai_s3_list: Irregular-part spraying: corners depend on touch.
Repair and recoating: people judge defects.
Process control: people adjust parameters.
Appearance decisions: people determine acceptance.
Safety protection: people maintain ventilation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that this occupation has moderately high exposure. Irregular parts, repairs, and small batches are difficult to standardize, so near-term replacement risk is low, while automated lines are absorbing uniform parts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure still means change. Simple repetitive spraying faces pressure, not irregular-part and process work. Workers who adjust processes and maintain appearance quality become more valuable as automation spreads.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Enter only if you can handle demanding conditions; steady hands and protective discipline are essential. Work on uniform parts is shrinking in the AI era, so develop irregular-part and process skills early.
Advance from knowing how to spray to understanding processes + managing appearance quality. Learn to work with automated lines and pursue line-leader roles.
Highlight credentials and the workpieces you have handled, clearly describing irregular-part experience. Specialized coating experience is preferred.
When hiring, assess steady hands and appearance judgment, not strength alone. Spray workers who maintain quality deserve additional compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Automated coating lines take over uniform parts, while workers shift toward irregular parts and process control.
Visual inspection reduces missed appearance defects.
Senior spray workers who collaborate with automated lines are in greater demand.

body: Painting and coating workers pretreat, spray, dip-coat, electrocoat, and dry metal or manufactured surfaces. They control coating thickness and appearance to provide corrosion-resistant and decorative protection, serving as frontline technical workers who ensure surface quality in manufacturing.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can manage itineraries and tickets, but guides still decide which parts to bring alive and how to handle unexpected events.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 55,800 travel guides were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 60,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,500 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 13,000 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $36,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace travel guides, but it will accelerate logistical work. Platforms speed up itineraries, ticketing, and navigation, shifting guides from showing the way toward in-depth narration, on-site adaptability, and experience management. Those who only recite scripts face the greatest pressure, while strong storytellers who adapt remain more secure.

Automatic ticket booking

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Showing the way and booking tickets are being accelerated, not the job of creating travel experiences. Strong storytellers who adapt become scarcer as efficiency improves. Guides who only recite scripts face the risk.

Advance from reciting scripts to in-depth, customized guiding, and learn niche routes.
Highlight routes you have led and clearly describe complex cases.
Do not hire only for speaking ability; assess whether candidates can think through unexpected situations.
